1_market_data_ingestion.details: All 24 dataset partitions pass rigorous OHLCV validation (High >= Low, High >= Open/Close, Low <= Open/Close, Volume >= 0). 0 corrupt records.

2_timestamp_alignment.details: All 5 canonical timeframe sets exhibit strictly hierarchical duration progression (HTF > MTF > LTF). Epoch alignment mathematically verified.

3_candle_close_availability.details: Verified that forming candles are strictly excluded. Only bars that have closed at or before the decision timestamp are visible.

4_swing_confirmation_latency.details: Swings require lookback=2 subsequent confirming bars. Swings are completely inaccessible to the engine until confirmation_timestamp.

5_candidate_generation.details: CandidateSetup adheres strictly to finite state transitions. Expirations, geometric rejections, and structural cancellations are causally recorded.

6_entry_timing.fill_model: Next-bar open or trigger close fill with adverse taker fee and slippage penalty.
6_entry_timing.details: 100% of executed trades exhibit entry_timestamp >= setup_timestamp. No retrospective fills.

7_stop_target_collision.code_rule: if hit_sl and hit_tp: hit_tp = False
7_stop_target_collision.details: Verified that when both Stop Loss and Take Profit levels are penetrated in the same bar, the Stop Loss is executed unconditionally first.

8_fees.details: Maker fees (0.00%) for limit target exits; Taker fees (0.05% / 5 bps) for market entries and stop-loss fills. Full round-trip fee deduction audited.

9_slippage.details: Adverse slippage penalty of 5.0 bps (0.05%) applied to all stop-loss market fills. Stop fills are strictly executed at current_stop * (1 - 0.0005) for longs.

10_position_sizing.details: Strict 1.0% maximum equity risk per trade verified. Position size scales inversely with stop distance: Units = (Equity * 0.01) / Stop_Distance.

11_portfolio_aggregation.details: Multi-stream trade ledger reconciles exactly with aggregate portfolio performance. Chronological equity and drawdown curves verified.

12_duplicate_economic_setups.duplication_mechanism: Overlapping multi-timeframe events (e.g. Set 1 vs Set 2) retesting identical higher-timeframe order blocks.
12_duplicate_economic_setups.details: Deduplication ledger established. All analyses explicitly report both Total Trades (59) and Unique Economic Setups (31).

13_partition_boundaries.details: Strict temporal quarantine verified. Zero data from 2023+ validation or 2024-2026 OOS was accessed during development experiments.

checks_performed: Zone creation bar close <= candidate interaction bar open
MTF realignment bar close <= LTF trigger bar
Entry order fill timestamp <= Exit order fill timestamp
Indicator visibility restricted strictly to closed historical bars
14_lookahead_bias.details: Zero lookahead anomalies found across all 59 baseline trades. Full point-in-time causality confirmed.

15_deterministic_reproducibility.floating_point_determinism: Verified to 6 decimal places across multiple replay executions
15_deterministic_reproducibility.details: Complete deterministic replay reproducibility verified. Identical historical inputs produce bit-for-bit identical trade ledgers.
